# What merged, what stayed open, and what I learned

::: {.entry-summary-strip}
`11 LASTING MERGES AT CUTOFF`{.entry-status .status-merged} `5 OPEN AUTHORED PRS`{.entry-status .status-open}
:::

## Outcome

The main completed result was PR #261. The multiline-text branch had started before GSoC and gone through several rounds of review. After the final test and formatting cleanup, it merged on August 19.

Not everything merged by August 24. Several branches were still under review, and the histogram work remained a proof of concept. I record those states directly instead of treating every branch as finished.

## Context

During this period, I completed the remaining PR #261 review changes and verified multiline plot titles, axis titles, legend titles, and `geom_text()` labels. I also finished the JavaScript recomputation path that had begun in Week 12.

## What I Did

- Merged [PR #261](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/261) on August 19 after completing its final review cleanup.
- Completed the browser-side histogram recomputation path in [PR #343](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/343), repaired its tests, and collected coverage for the new JavaScript file.
- Continued contributing implementation, tests, documentation, and simplification to Toby Hocking’s [PR #253](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/253).
- Revised PR #288 and PR #339 after review and upstream text-rendering changes, and reviewed PR #344’s failure-path coverage.

## Learnings

At the beginning of the project, I often changed the code closest to the visible failure. By the final week, I was more likely to stop first and ask where the state came from: the R compiler, JavaScript renderer, shared browser session, or CI workflow.

Reviewing someone else’s PR also became a normal part of the work. I did not author PR #344, but checking its failure path and coverage output was still useful project work.

## Challenges / Notes

Academic work and hackathons reduced the time I could give the project near the end, so I requested a two-week extension. I include that as a project-management challenge, not a technical result.

PR #336 was open and ready at the August 24 cutoff. It merged August 25 and is not included in the cutoff total of eleven lasting merges.

## Next Week Targets

Publish short technical notes for merged features, continue the open renderer reviews, and keep every post-cutoff outcome dated separately from this submission.

The plot exercises the shipped multiline behavior in one place: the plot title, both axis titles, the legend title, and every `geom_text()` label render on multiple lines without overlap or cropping.

<details class="demo-code">
<summary>View the essential R code</summary>

```r
animint(
  multiline = ggplot(label_data, aes(x, y, colour = group)) +
    geom_point(aes(key = group), clickSelects = "group") +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = label_y, label = label, key = group),
      clickSelects = "group",
      showSelected = character()
    ) +
    scale_color_discrete(name = "Feature\nworkstream") +
    ggtitle("Multi-line text in Animint2\nMerged in PR #261") +
    xlab("Interactive labels\nclick a point or legend entry") +
    ylab("Renderer output\nwith measured spacing")
)
```

</details>
